fragments.text: Oh, I am seeing a highlighting collision at the end of *codex-repl:codex-10* on "for now I think"

reply_text:
Fixing the overlap now: intent cue and red term shared "now"; adding a test.Test fails on the old code, passes on the new. Committing and loading into your Emacs.㊢ (the collision on "for now I think") I fixed it and loaded the fix into your Emacs. That phrase now shows only the "for now" underline. The cause was two cues overlapping on the same word: "for now" is an intent cue, "now I think" is a red term, and both covered "now". My earlier fix only skipped red terms that were exactly the same phrase as an intent cue, so a partial overlap still got through.

🈖 (the rule now) An intent underline and a red term never share a character, and the intent underline takes precedence. The two are painted at different times, so the rule is enforced from both sides:
- a red term is skipped if it would touch an existing intent underline;
- when an intent underline is painted, any red overlay under it is removed.

㊬ (what I checked)
- I added a test that paints the phrase in both orders and expects only the intent underline. It fails on the previous code and passes on the new.
- All 21 tests for red terms, 象 and intent underlines pass.
- In `*codex-repl:codex-10*`, the only highlighting left on that phrase is "for now".
- The commit is `5e9b7c86`.

㊢ (decision log) The previous fix, which stops the tests writing into the live decision log, is commit `3c00bd2c`.
